evidence_slice: St Helens Borough Council states that the Bold Forest Garden Village Masterplan was adopted on 21 January 2026, was developed in line with Local Plan site allocation 4HA and Policy LPA11, covers a 128-hectare site and aims to deliver around 3,000 new homes with 30% affordable housing. The council's adopted-plans page states that the St Helens Borough Local Plan up to 2037 was adopted in July 2022. The council's published decision record identifies 4HA as the Bold Forest Garden Village Local Plan allocation and notes a minimum of 510 dwellings during the plan period. The National Data Library record published by St Helens Council describes the Local Plan Allocated Housing Site dataset as polygon data with site-reference and site-name fields. Exact 4HA polygon bytes were not acquired in this chat transport; the exact official identifier is retained and canonical parcel spatial join remains delegated to local OpenCode.
